gaps.explanation: The General Fund budget-and-actual schedule (p8) prints 'Grants and donations' 70,233 among RECEIPTS (printed Total receipts 39,664,105), while the cash-basis governmental funds statement (p4) prints Grants and donations 70,233 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES, outside Total receipts (General 39,593,872; Total 39,843,139 printed; its rows add to 39,843,138). 39,664,105 - 39,593,872 = 70,233. Schedule 39,913,372 - 70,233 = 39,843,139 vs statement rows 39,843,138: the remaining 1 is report rounding (Intergovernmental - state General 338,472 + Bond 6,854 = 345,326 vs printed 345,325; inside the General Fund the schedule's Other miscellaneous 44,422 vs statement 43,232 (+1,190, Library state aid) is offset by its Intergovernmental lines 337,281 vs 338,472 (-1,191)). The detail line (Budget and Actual - General Fund, 'Grants and donations' 70,233, p8) is a printed schedule line and is kept. No fix.

Statement (accrual, p6 Total column): total operating revenues 4,404,398 + interest income 32,879 + unrealized gain/loss 2,155 = 4,439,432 (bond proceeds 921,562 excluded). Detail is the budgetary-basis proprietary schedule (p10): Total revenues actual 4,350,120 (utility sales 4,315,087 + interest 35,033). Utility sales 4,315,087 = operating revenues 4,404,398 - increase in accounts receivable 89,311 (cash flows p7); interest 35,033 = 32,879 + 2,155 - 1 rounding. Gap 89,312 = 89,311 + 1. No fix.

Statement (accrual, p6 Total column): total operating expenses 4,364,512 (incl. depreciation 237,151) + interest expense 30,112 = 4,394,624. Detail is the budgetary-basis proprietary schedule (p10): Total expenditures actual 3,401,121 printed (Water (443) + Sewer 3,401,564; Operating 4,134,436, Capital improvements (901,275) i.e. net of the 921,562 bond proceeds, Debt service 167,960; detail lines 3,401,122). The printed totals really differ (993,502): budgetary basis nets bond proceeds against capital improvements and has no depreciation. No fix.
